title:
A table worth
gathering around.
lead: Steam, lanterns, dim sum and skewers at 145 Mulberry St. Our own photos and film, plus moments from Instagram and TikTok.

sign.alt: Easy Joy storefront with the yellow 意中人 sign on Mulberry Street

chapters.title: The pot
chapters.text: Pick your broths, add the meat and let the table get to work. All-you-can-eat covers the hot pot.

chapters.title: A little dim sum, too
chapters.text: Made by hand and steamed fresh. Order à la carte any time; before 5 PM, 4–6 kinds come around on the cart with the $28 hot pot.

chapters.text: Bring your friends and family. Big tables, lanterns and the yellow sign on Mulberry Street.
